demoted_gold_chunk.text: The CellRank algorithm. The aim of the CellRank algorithm is to detect the initial, intermediate and terminal states of a system, and to define a global fate map that assigns, for each cell, the probability of reaching each terminal state. CellRank can compute gene expression trends along trajectories in the inferred fate map and visualize these in several ways. Inputs to CellRank are a cell (N) by gene (G) count matrix X∈R N×G, and velocity matrix V∈RN×G that defines a vector field representing RNA velocities14,15. Note that CellRank can use any vector field; for example, V could represent directed information given by metabolic labeling4–6,73.
